stockCount.title: Stock Count
stockCount.subtitle: Count physical product quantities in the warehouse, detect differences and update the system.
stockCount.confirm.title: Confirm and Complete Count
stockCount.confirm.message: The count cannot be edited after completion. Continue?
stockCount.toast.startError: Failed to start a new count.
stockCount.toast.completed: Count completed and differences applied to stock.
stockCount.noSerials: No serial numbers for this product
stockCount.toast.scanSerialRequired: Serial-tracked product: scan the serial number or tick it in the list
stockCount.toast.scanLotHint: Lot-tracked product: enter the quantity on the matching lot
stockCount.toast.completedPending: Count completed. The differences of {count} line(s) whose value exceeds the approval threshold were sent to a second administrator; the other differences were applied to stock.
stockCount.sentForApprovalHint: This difference exceeded the approval threshold, so it was not applied; it is booked once a second administrator approves it under Stock movements > Pending approvals.
stockCount.tutanakHint: The user completing the count approves the report and cannot be a counter. The count date may be up to 3 months before or 2 months after the inventory date; movements in between are rolled forward / back.
stockCount.cancelConfirm.title: Cancel this count?
stockCount.cancelConfirm.message: Count {number} will be cancelled without booking any stock difference. This cannot be undone.
stockCount.toast.cancelled: Count cancelled; no differences were booked.
stockCount.toast.cancelError: The count could not be cancelled.
